assumptions.spacing.scale: 1.0 with scale-with-font true, so Style.space(px) = px (shell.toml.tpl:73-74; Style.qml:213-225)
assumptions.bar: top, 26px tall, no notch (shell/plugins/bar/Bar.qml:75, 716; Style.qml:344; shell.toml.tpl:16)
assumptions.monospace: Style.font.family is the fontconfig alias "monospace" (Style.qml:271, 324). Omarchy ships ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd-basic (install/omarchy-base.packages:149) and its terminals name "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font" (config/alacritty/alacritty.toml:10); the alias target is resolved at runtime by fc-match (Style.qml:517-527).
assumptions.type scale at 12: caption 10, bodySmall 11, body 12, subtitle 13, title 14, heading 16, display 24, displayLarge 28, icon 14, iconLarge 18 (Style.qml:329-340)
assumptions.theme: Expressions are over colors.toml keys as rendered by default/themed/shell.toml.tpl. The default theme is Tokyo Night (install/user/theme.sh:10); its literal values are in notes.

notifications.layout: One persistent overlay layer per output (namespace omarchy-notifications). The deck appears only on the output that was focused when the first card arrived. The deck hangs from the top-right corner. The card's outer right edge is 5px from the screen's right edge. Its outer top edge is 31px below the screen top: the 26px top bar plus a 5px gap. Cards are 380px wide, with a 2px border on all sides, square corners and an opaque background. Inside the border are 12px of horizontal padding and 10px of vertical padding (7px when there is no body). The content is one row: an optional 40x40 icon slot, a 12px gap (8px for a compact glyph), then a text column. Within the text column the headline comes first: the summary in Liberation Sans 14 bold, wrapping to at most 3 lines. A verification-code mark sits 7px after the end of the title text. Right-aligned on the same line is the relative time in monospace 11, dimmed; it is empty for the first 5 minutes. On hover the time crossfades to a close mark (U+2715). The body comes 3px below the headline, in Liberation Sans 14 regular, slightly dimmed, clamped to 2 lines with an ellipsis. The icon is centred vertically against the resting height of the text block. When the text block is shorter than the icon, the text is centred against the icon instead. When the card offers actions, a button bar is attached flush to the bottom edge inside the border. It has a 1px hairline above it, equal segments separated by 1px hairlines, up to 3 per row, 35px per row (1px rule + 34px segment), and centred monospace 12 labels. Omarchy draws no app-name line, no countdown or progress bar and no urgency stripe. Newest cards insert at the top. Cards group into decks by source/app. A collapsed deck shows its front card. Up to 2 more cards peek 10px lower each, scaled to 0.965 and 0.93 about the top-centre, at opacity 0.85 and 0.55. Their text is hidden and they take the front card's height. Decks are separated by 11px. Hovering a deck opens it: its cards list vertically with 6px gaps, timers pause, and only the hovered card shows its buttons. A lone card on screen also opens its body to 8 lines on hover.

osd.layout: A single card centred horizontally on the focused monitor, with its outer bottom edge 67px above the screen's bottom edge. Exclusive zones are ignored, so the offset is from the screen edge. The card has square corners, a 2px border in the popups border colour (accent, or the Hyprland active-border gradient), and a background of 'background' at 0.97 alpha. Padding is 16px on every side inside the border. The content row is 28px tall, so the card is 2+16+28+16+2 = 64px tall. A progress OSD (volume, brightness, keyboard backlight) shows, left to right: a 28px monospace Nerd Font glyph in foreground, a 16px gap, a 142x6 track, a 16px gap, and the percentage. The glyph column is as wide as the wider ink box of the current glyph and U+F028. The track is foreground at 0.45 with an accent fill from the left and no rounding. The percentage is monospace 14 bold in foreground, right-aligned in a column as wide as '100%'. The width is 2+16+iconInk+16+142+16+valueW+16+2. A message OSD (mic mute, media) shows the glyph, an 11px gap, then the message in monospace 14 bold. The message is left-aligned, up to 190px wide (325px for media) and elided after that. The OSD appears instantly, without a fade. It hides after 1200ms, and every new show restarts that timer. While it is open, value changes animate the fill width over 140ms OutCubic. It takes no input.

lock.layout: The lock is a full-screen session-lock surface on every output. From back to front: a solid 'background' fill; the current wallpaper, centre-cropped to fill; and the same wallpaper heavily blurred on top, with contrast reduced by 0.08. A video wallpaper uses a cached poster frame instead. There is no clock, no date, no avatar, no username and nothing above the field. The only element is a 381x67px password field centred on the screen. These sizes are hard-coded and do not follow the spacing scale. The field has a 3px border with square corners and a fill of 'background' at alpha 0.8. While the field is empty it shows the placeholder 'Enter Password', centred, in monospace 18 regular, in the placeholder colour. Typing replaces the placeholder with centred U+25CF dots in monospace 21 with 3px letter-spacing, in the text colour. A 2px text-coloured cursor shows only when there is text. Dots shrink to fit once they would overflow the 18px side insets. While a password is checked, the field shows 'Checking…' in the text colour and input is disabled. On failure the field clears and shows 'Authentication failed (N)' in italic 18 in red, and the border switches to red. Typing clears the error. When a fingerprint reader is enrolled, a fingerprint glyph (monospace 20) sits inside the right edge, 21px from the outer edge. If the reader is unreachable, a crossed-out glyph in red replaces it, and 'Fingerprint reader unavailable' appears 18px below the field in italic 16 red. After 5s idle the lock turns the displays off.

notes: Runtime: 'monospace' resolves through fontconfig (Style.qml:517-527). Stock Omarchy ships JetBrainsMono Nerd Font (install/omarchy-base.packages:149), and all Nerd Font glyph codepoints above assume that font. Notification title and body use 'Liberation Sans' by name (Toast.qml:399, 510). That font is not listed in omarchy-base.packages, so Qt falls back if it is missing. Treat it as a requirement to load Liberation Sans (or the metric-compatible Arimo) in the web replica.

Runtime: text line heights come from font metrics. Liberation Sans 14px is about 16px per line (ascent 0.905em + descent 0.212em = 15.6px). Using that, a lettered card with summary only is 4 + 14 + 40 = 58px (it matches the code's fallback, Service.qml:536). Summary + 1-line body is 4 + 20 + 40 = 64px. Summary + 2-line body is about 4 + 20 + (16+3+32) = 75px. Each action row adds 35px. These are estimates, not source values.

Runtime: the OSD icon column width is the ink bounding box of U+F028 at 28px in the resolved font (Osd.qml:42-45). The value column is the advance width of '100%' in monospace bold 14. Neither is in source. With JetBrains Mono the value column is about ceil(4*0.6*14) = 34px.

Runtime: bar thickness comes from bar.barSizeFor(screen) and can grow on a notched panel (Delivery.js:78-84; Bar.qml:779-781). 26 is the default for a top bar. With a bottom or left bar, the toast top offset is 5. With a right bar, the right offset becomes barThickness + 5 (Delivery.js:88-97).
Runtime: Style.gapsOut = round(general:gaps_out / 2). The first number of the css value is used (Style.qml:393-403). 'omarchy toggle window-gaps' changes it.
Runtime: Style.duration(ms) is 0 when Hyprland animations are disabled, which turns off every QML animation listed (Style.qml:363-367, 477-490).

Runtime: the notification layer stays mapped while idle (Service.qml:1494-1512), so Hyprland's layersIn fade (default/hypr/looknfeel.lua:88) affects only its first map. All per-card motion is QML. With the 'window-glassy' toggle, Hyprland blurs behind the omarchy-notifications and omarchy-osd layers (default/hypr/toggles/window-glassy.lua:10-14). That is off by default.
Colour helpers: Util.alpha(c, a) replaces the alpha; it does not multiply it (Util.qml:44-48). Qt.darker(c, f) divides the HSV value by f, which is the same as dividing each RGB channel by f.

Gradient borders: when colors.toml defines hyprland_active_border (e.g. 'rgba(..) rgba(..) 45deg'), the toast, OSD and lock borders are drawn as gradients by BorderOverlay (Border.qml:80-93, 141-151; BorderSurface.qml:25-39). Of the stock themes, only hackerman, last-horizon and solitude define one. Tokyo Night uses flat accent.

Tokyo Night (default theme, themes/tokyo-night/colors.toml:3-17): background #1a1b26, foreground #a9b1d6, accent #7aa2f7, red #f7768e. Derived: dim = darker(fg,1.4) ~ #797e99; body = darker(fg,1.15) ~ #939aba.

Tokyo Night lock override: themes/tokyo-night/shell.lock.toml:1-6 replaces the whole [lock] section (docs/theming.md:181-186; bin/omarchy-theme-set-templates:255-313). It sets text, placeholder, text-error, border, border-active and border-error all to #a9b1d6. Under Tokyo Night the placeholder and the error are foreground, and the outline is a 3px foreground line, not accent or red. background and selection fall back to Color.qml defaults: background @ 0.8 (Color.qml:122) and accent @ 0.45 (Color.qml:129), matching the template. A replica of 'stock Omarchy 4 on Tokyo Night' should use these overrides.

Surprising: the notification card has no app-name line and no countdown/progress bar. The 'countdown' colour key only colours links (Toast.qml:164 comment, 509). Urgency has no visual effect under stock tokens (Toast.qml:73-77, 313); critical cards just never time out. The idle lock 'border' key is unused; the field always uses border-active.

Surprising: volume key presses always show U+F028 (or U+EEE8 when muted or 0%), not a level-tiered speaker (MediaModel.js:173-174). Only the audio panel's slider passes level-tiered glyphs (audio/Panel.qml:475-486). When mute is toggled, the bar keeps showing the stored volume.

Surprising: the OSD fill uses the foundational accent and the background uses the foundational background at 0.97. Neither reads the [popups] background/alpha tokens (Osd.qml:143, 180). Only the border and text come from [popups].
Surprising: lock field geometry (381x67, 3px outline, 18px insets) is hard-coded px and ignores base-size and spacing scale. Its fonts derive from heading (16) and do scale (LockView.qml:24-29).

Unresolved: the exact Gaussian equivalent of QtQuick MultiEffect blur (blur 1.0, blurMax 128, blurMultiplier 1.25) is renderer-defined. A CSS approximation (e.g. filter: blur(~40-64px) contrast(0.92)) must be tuned by eye against a screenshot. The repo ships themes/tokyo-night/unlock.png and preview-unlock.png, which may serve as references.
Unresolved: the close mark '✕' (Toast.qml:470-477) sets no font.family, so it renders in Qt's application default font, not the monospace alias.

Not used by these three surfaces: PopupCard.qml and OpticalGlyph.qml are not imported by notifications, OSD or lock (grep over shell/plugins/{notifications,osd,lock}). [popups] tokens reach the OSD only through Border.surfaceSpec('popups', …) and Color.popups.text.
